verdict.rationale: Base44 supports GitHub sync for local development in a developer's own editor (base44-docs-2, base44-docs-18), plus a CLI (base44-docs-5, base44-docs-24) and 'bring your own agent' sandbox connection (base44-docs-3, base44-docs-37) for pushing changes back to the platform. Eject/clone commands also let developers pull code locally to work with own tooling (base44-docs-1, base44-docs-22). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that GitHub sync round-trips changes reliably without conflicts, and more detail on push-back mechanics beyond docs claims.
